allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: SBC Exports Limited has informed the  withdrawal/cancellation of the proposed Preferential Issue of 27516513 Equity Share of the face value of INR 1 each at an price of INR 36.00,  upon the conversion unsecured Loan of INR 99,05,94,474/- only, to promoters and promoter Group on a preferential basis and all ancillary Resolutions related thereof earlier approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 29th May, 2026.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: SBC Exports Limited has informed the withdrawal/cancellation of the resolution relating to the issuance of equity shares to promoters and promoter Group by conversion of existing unsecured loans on a preferential basis and all ancillary Resolutions related thereof approved by the Board at its meeting held on 29th May, 2026.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: SBC Exports Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Hold on Preferential Issue Approved by the Board on 29th May, 2026 Due to Procedural Complexities

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: SBC Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about the  Approved the issuance of equity shares to promoters and promoter group by conversion of existing unsecured loans on a preferential basis.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: SBC Exports Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026 and the issuance of equity shares to promoters and promoter group by conversion of existing unsecured loans on a preferential basis.
